title: Spatial Data V2.0
description: Spatial Data produced by the Motion Actuation Subsystem describing the Spatial Attitude of the Connected Autonomous Vehicle.

SpatialDataID.description: Unique identifier of this Spatial Data instance.

SpaceTime.description: Spatial Attitude and Time of this Spatial Data instance.

OdometerData.description: Distance travelled by the CAV, expressed in metres (m).

SpeedometerData.description: Speed of the CAV, expressed in metres/second (m/s).

AccelerometerData.description: Acceleration of the CAV, expressed in metres/second/second (m/s²).

InclinometerData.description: Inclination of the CAV in the direction of travel and perpendicular to it, in degrees (°).

LongitudinalInclination.description: CAV inclination in the direction of travel, in degrees (°).

LateralInclination.description: CAV inclination perpendicular to the direction of travel, in degrees (°).

GyroscopeData.description: Rate at which the CAV turns about its axes, in degrees/second (°/s), positive anticlockwise.

YawRate.description: Rate of turn about the vertical axis, in degrees/second (°/s), positive to the left.

PitchRate.description: Rate of turn about the lateral axis, in degrees/second (°/s).

RollRate.description: Rate of turn about the longitudinal axis, in degrees/second (°/s).

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Spatial Data instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Spatial Data instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
